body:
Hi there! I reproduced this on macOS and Windows. A fix is queued. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested master ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/91a74c45e6fce92ac284d1713b156a70d477965a)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: Call runVerification with a non-empty Config.PublicKey (the pinned trust anchor) and a release Verification that carries only a Digest, or no Verification at all. In the reported behaviour the PublicKey is ignored on those paths, so verification returns nil and the artifact is staged and installed.

Expected: When Config.PublicKey is set, a release with no valid signature is rejected (fail closed).

**macOS 26.6.2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go test -json -count=1 -timeout=90s -run ^TestWorkflowReproUnsignedReleaseInstallsWithPublicKey$ ./pkg/updater
ProductVersion:		26.6.2
BuildVersion:		25G83
go version go1.27.1 darwin/arm64
REPRO_OBSERVATION: digest-only err=<nil> keyLen=91
REPRO_OBSERVATION: no-verification err=<nil>
REPRO_OBSERVATION: nil-verification err=<nil>
REPRO_ASSERTION: digest-only release accepted with PublicKey set, err=<nil> keyLen=91
REPRO_ASSERTION: release with no verification accepted with PublicKey set, err=<nil>
```

**Windows 11 24H2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go test -json -count=1 -timeout=90s -run ^TestWorkflowReproUnsignedReleaseInstallsWithPublicKey$ ./pkg/updater
Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26100.0
go version go1.27.1 windows/arm64
REPRO_OBSERVATION: digest-only err=<nil> keyLen=91
REPRO_OBSERVATION: no-verification err=<nil>
REPRO_OBSERVATION: nil-verification err=<nil>
REPRO_ASSERTION: digest-only release accepted with PublicKey set, err=<nil> keyLen=91
REPRO_ASSERTION: release with no verification accepted with PublicKey set, err=<nil>
```

The failing regression assertion is the evidence; compilation and setup succeeded.

Scope: a Go package test against this pinned version, simulating the reported failure. It does not establish behavior in every release or exercise the GUI. Screenshots are not applicable. 

Revision selection: current public master. Results apply only to the pinned source and OS shown; an inferred version is not attributed to the reporter.

Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
